blocks.text:
# The genuinely macOS-only terminal behavior keeps its dedicated gates:
  # cube-kernel-live (above) runs the real sandbox-exec E2E (test/cube/
  # backends) on fa-m5-1, and the mac-only CLI lines (shift_hid CoreGraphics
  # probe, stty -f device flag) stay unit-covered on ubuntu
  # (test/cli/shift_hid_test.dart, fa_tui_controller_overlay_test.dart).
  # Consequence: the fa-m5 runner-pick probe (M5_POOL) is GONE and the mac
  # leg merged INTO the linux leg below — ONE sharded PTY/CLI integration
  # job on ubuntu-24.04-arm that now also carries the per-shard coverage +
  # dart-json/junit reporting the gate consumes. A PR validation's PTY legs
  # never wait on fa-m5-1; hosted macOS (10x minute cost) is never used.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  pty-integration-linux:
    # THE PR PTY/CLI integration leg (gh-1005: the former mac leg merged in;
    # before that, issue #931 part 2 sharded ONE ~40-min job into 3
    # duration-balanced shards — scripts/test_integration_shards.json,
    # file-level units). New integration-tagged files bin-pack in at runtime
    # (shard_files.py --tags integration), so a PR adding one never
    # silently skips it. Explicit --concurrency=4 bounds in-suite
    # parallelism (part 3.3 — package:test forbids `concurrency` in
    # dart_test.yaml tag overrides, so the knob lives here; it bounds
    # concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB — the rate-limit rationale is
    # documented on the llm tag in dart_test.yaml).
    # Per-shard coverage artifacts merge in pty-coverage-gate —
    # a single shard's ratchet would see partial lib/src/cli coverage
    # and false-regress. Each shard also emits the dart json
    # file-reporter: junit feeds rebalancing/budget-tightening PRs, the
    # raw json feeds the #928 duration gate (pty-coverage-gate below).
    # gh-1300: needs the once-per-run AOT build; FA_BIN points every CLI
    # spawn (PTY harness + headless helpers) at the prebuilt binary.
    needs: [fa-aot-build]
    name: PTY/CLI integration (linux, shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    # 40 > 30: the leg now carries the coverage + file-reporter overhead the
    # old mac leg had (the coverage-free linux twin never paid it) and arm64
    # Graviton cores run somewhat slower than the M-series minis did — margin
    # without stretching the watchdog much.
    timeout-minutes: 40
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2]
    env:
      # Secret shape (review 2026-09-23): this is the pull_request-time leg
      # that receives real provider secrets. GitHub withholds secrets from
      # forks, so external contributions never see them — but every
      # SAME-REPO branch runs this suite with the keys in its process
      # environment before human review (this repo's agent-authored-branch
      # model). The marginal escalation vs the nightly (same suites, same
      # keys, post-merge on main) is small and the watchdog already hands
      # RELEASE_PAT to same-repo PRs; documented here so the assumption is
      # explicit, not implicit.
      #
      # The live-provider legs (unlocked by these keys) load extra
      # lib/src/cli surface into the coverage measurement, so a no-key run
      # measures a DIFFERENT — lower-numbered — value; missing keys (forks)
      # self-skip those legs gracefully and the gate stays honest either
      # way.
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # gh-1300: the AOT binary built once per run by fa-aot-build. The
      # guard FAILS the shard loudly if the artifact is missing or dead —
      # a silent JIT fallback would hide the optimization from AC1's
      # before/after numbers.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: fa-aot-bin
          path: fa-local/bundle
      # Artifact zips do NOT preserve the exec bit (download-artifact
      # README: "post-download the file is no longer guaranteed to be set
      # as an executable"). Run 37446280743: `test -x` below failed
      # silently ~20 ms in on EVERY shard — the gate went red before a
      # single test ran. Restore the mode the build job shipped; the
      # smoke below still verifies the restored binary is executable and
      # boots (never a silent JIT fallback). Content integrity is not
      # affected: download-artifact digest-validates (digest-mismatch:
      # error default), so this chmod only ever touches the verified
      # bundle the fa-aot-build job produced.
      - name: Restore exec bit (artifact zips drop permissions)
        run: chmod +x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
      - name: Smoke the AOT binary (fail loud, never JIT-fallback)
        run: |
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (linux, shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn (pty_harness + the
          # headless helpers via faCliCommand) runs the AOT binary —
          # ~1 s per spawn instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on
          # loaded ARM runners). Per-test isolation is unchanged.
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          # gh-1199 AC1: --exclude-tag llm keeps every live-provider file
          # out of the merge-blocking selection (manifest unit AND runtime
          # bin-pack); --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm is the dart-test
          # backstop. AC6: the quarantine filter drops flake-quarantined
          # files (scripts/test_quarantine.json) pending their fix PRs.
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_integration_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }} --tags integration --exclude browser_ext --exclude-tag llm | python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py)
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          if [ -z "$targets" ]; then
            echo "shard fully quarantined — nothing to run"
            exit 0
          fi
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm \
            --concurrency=4 \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
      # The file-reporter writes the json even on a RED leg — convert +

  full-quality:
    name: Full quality gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1522: the publish dry-run rehearses the tag-stamped stage —
          # tag math needs the full tag graph (blobless per gh-1477).
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - run: dart pub get

      # gh-1522: the dry-run now rehearses the REAL publish payload — the
      # staged tree stamped with the NEXT tag version — so a stamp failure
      # (placeholder leak, changelog-section generation, staged-version
      # desync) surfaces nightly, not at tag time. Publish-blocking problems
      # (undeclared lib/ imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface
      # only in the tag-time publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared
      # package:cryptography import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags.
      # --ignore-warnings: the two known layout warnings (gitignored
      # install_local.sh, docs/ naming) must not redden the nightly, while
      # validation ERRORS — "does not have X in the dependencies section of
      # pubspec.yaml" — still fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a
      # publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated
      # metadata reads, so resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the
      # publish job); --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run on the staged tree (gh-1522)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          latest=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1)
          latest="${latest#v}"
          IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$latest"
          next="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))"
          echo "rehearsing the publish of the NEXT tag: v$next"
          bash scripts/stage_publish_package.sh /tmp/publish-stage "$next"
          (cd /tmp/publish-stage && dart pub get && dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings)

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The repo-wide `dart analyze` also walks office_addin/dart; without
      # its package config the analyzer cannot resolve
      # `package:fa_office_agent/...` imports (nightly full-quality was red
      # on email_quarantine_test.dart since the add-in landed). ci.yml's
      # analyze job already does this — nightly must match.
      - name: Office add-in pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        run: dart pub get --directory=office_addin/dart

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # without it the analyzer fails with asset_does_not_exist (a fresh
      # clone hits the same warning locally).
      - name: Create placeholder .env for the example app
        run: touch [REDACTED:Credential File]

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored (real keys stay local); the
      # repo-wide analyze fails on the unresolved import without it. The
      # tracked placeholder makes it compile (Firebase init is skipped for

      - name: Create placeholder firebase_options.dart for the example app

blocks.text:
# The genuinely macOS-only terminal behavior keeps its dedicated gates:
  # cube-kernel-live (above) runs the real sandbox-exec E2E (test/cube/
  # backends) on fa-m5-1, and the mac-only CLI lines (shift_hid CoreGraphics
  # probe, stty -f device flag) stay unit-covered on ubuntu
  # (test/cli/shift_hid_test.dart, fa_tui_controller_overlay_test.dart).
  # Consequence: the fa-m5 runner-pick probe (M5_POOL) is GONE and the mac
  # leg merged INTO the linux leg below — ONE sharded PTY/CLI integration
  # job on ubuntu-24.04-arm that now also carries the per-shard coverage +
  # dart-json/junit reporting the gate consumes. A PR validation's PTY legs
  # never wait on fa-m5-1; hosted macOS (10x minute cost) is never used.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  pty-integration-linux:
    # THE PR PTY/CLI integration leg (gh-1005: the former mac leg merged in;
    # before that, issue #931 part 2 sharded ONE ~40-min job into 3
    # duration-balanced shards — scripts/test_integration_shards.json,
    # file-level units). New integration-tagged files bin-pack in at runtime
    # (shard_files.py --tags integration), so a PR adding one never
    # silently skips it. Explicit --concurrency=4 bounds in-suite
    # parallelism (part 3.3 — package:test forbids `concurrency` in
    # dart_test.yaml tag overrides, so the knob lives here; it bounds
    # concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB — the rate-limit rationale is
    # documented on the llm tag in dart_test.yaml).
    # Per-shard coverage artifacts merge in pty-coverage-gate —
    # a single shard's ratchet would see partial lib/src/cli coverage
    # and false-regress. Each shard also emits the dart json
    # file-reporter: junit feeds rebalancing/budget-tightening PRs, the
    # raw json feeds the #928 duration gate (pty-coverage-gate below).
    # gh-1300: needs the once-per-run AOT build; FA_BIN points every CLI
    # spawn (PTY harness + headless helpers) at the prebuilt binary.
    needs: [fa-aot-build]
    name: PTY/CLI integration (linux, shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    # 40 > 30: the leg now carries the coverage + file-reporter overhead the
    # old mac leg had (the coverage-free linux twin never paid it) and arm64
    # Graviton cores run somewhat slower than the M-series minis did — margin
    # without stretching the watchdog much.
    timeout-minutes: 40
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2]
    env:
      # Secret shape (review 2026-09-23): this is the pull_request-time leg
      # that receives real provider secrets. GitHub withholds secrets from
      # forks, so external contributions never see them — but every
      # SAME-REPO branch runs this suite with the keys in its process
      # environment before human review (this repo's agent-authored-branch
      # model). The marginal escalation vs the nightly (same suites, same
      # keys, post-merge on main) is small and the watchdog already hands
      # RELEASE_PAT to same-repo PRs; documented here so the assumption is
      # explicit, not implicit.
      #
      # The live-provider legs (unlocked by these keys) load extra
      # lib/src/cli surface into the coverage measurement, so a no-key run
      # measures a DIFFERENT — lower-numbered — value; missing keys (forks)
      # self-skip those legs gracefully and the gate stays honest either
      # way.
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # gh-1300: the AOT binary built once per run by fa-aot-build. The
      # guard FAILS the shard loudly if the artifact is missing or dead —
      # a silent JIT fallback would hide the optimization from AC1's
      # before/after numbers.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: fa-aot-bin
          path: fa-local/bundle
      # Artifact zips do NOT preserve the exec bit (download-artifact
      # README: "post-download the file is no longer guaranteed to be set
      # as an executable"). Run 37446280743: `test -x` below failed
      # silently ~20 ms in on EVERY shard — the gate went red before a
      # single test ran. Restore the mode the build job shipped; the
      # smoke below still verifies the restored binary is executable and
      # boots (never a silent JIT fallback). Content integrity is not
      # affected: download-artifact digest-validates (digest-mismatch:
      # error default), so this chmod only ever touches the verified
      # bundle the fa-aot-build job produced.
      - name: Restore exec bit (artifact zips drop permissions)
        run: chmod +x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
      - name: Smoke the AOT binary (fail loud, never JIT-fallback)
        run: |
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (linux, shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn (pty_harness + the
          # headless helpers via faCliCommand) runs the AOT binary —
          # ~1 s per spawn instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on
          # loaded ARM runners). Per-test isolation is unchanged.
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          # gh-1199 AC1: --exclude-tag llm keeps every live-provider file
          # out of the merge-blocking selection (manifest unit AND runtime
          # bin-pack); --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm is the dart-test
          # backstop. AC6: the quarantine filter drops flake-quarantined
          # files (scripts/test_quarantine.json) pending their fix PRs.
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_integration_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }} --tags integration --exclude browser_ext --exclude-tag llm | python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py)
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          if [ -z "$targets" ]; then
            echo "shard fully quarantined — nothing to run"
            exit 0
          fi
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm \
            --concurrency=4 \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
      # The file-reporter writes the json even on a RED leg — convert +
      # upload must not be chained into the failing step (#928 review):
      # timing evidence is exactly what red runs need to keep.
      - name: junit durations (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json
          test-results/junit-integration-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml
      # Raw dart json for the #928 duration gate (per-test spans incl. suite
      # paths); junit is the human/rebalancer-facing form of the same data.
      # Upload MUST stay on the current upload-artifact line (gh-995): the
      # gate's download-artifact v8 digest-validates every download, so an
      # old-line upload digest-mismatches and the shard merge loses its
      # report (test/release_hygiene_test.dart pins the pin).
      #
      # gh-1412: each evidence upload carries a one-shot retry (the step
      # right after it, same pinned action). The gh-1412…

  full-quality:

    permissions:

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - run: dart pub get

      # gh-1522: the dry-run now rehearses the REAL publish payload — the
      # staged tree stamped with the NEXT tag version — so a stamp failure
      # (placeholder leak, changelog-section generation, staged-version
      # desync) surfaces nightly, not at tag time. Publish-blocking problems
      # (undeclared lib/ imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface
      # only in the tag-time publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared
      # package:cryptography import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags.
      # --ignore-warnings: the two known layout warnings (gitignored
      # install_local.sh, docs/ naming) must not redden the nightly, while
      # validation ERRORS — "does not have X in the dependencies section of
      # pubspec.yaml" — still fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a
      # publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated
      # metadata reads, so resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the
      # publish job); --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run on the staged tree (gh-1522)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          latest=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1)
          latest="${latest#v}"
          IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$latest"
          next="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))"
          echo "rehearsing the publish of the NEXT tag: v$next"
          bash scripts/stage_publish_package.sh /tmp/publish-stage "$next"
          (cd /tmp/publish-stage && dart pub get && dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings)

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.

      - name: Create placeholder firebase_options.dart for the example app

      - name: File size guard (no dart file over 2800 lines)

            -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 2800 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)

      - name: dart analyze

blocks.text:
# The genuinely macOS-only terminal behavior keeps its dedicated gates:
  # cube-kernel-live (above) runs the real sandbox-exec E2E (test/cube/
  # backends) on fa-m5-1, and the mac-only CLI lines (shift_hid CoreGraphics
  # probe, stty -f device flag) stay unit-covered on ubuntu
  # (test/cli/shift_hid_test.dart, fa_tui_controller_overlay_test.dart).
  # Consequence: the fa-m5 runner-pick probe (M5_POOL) is GONE and the mac
  # leg merged INTO the linux leg below — ONE sharded PTY/CLI integration
  # job on ubuntu-24.04-arm that now also carries the per-shard coverage +
  # dart-json/junit reporting the gate consumes. A PR validation's PTY legs
  # never wait on fa-m5-1; hosted macOS (10x minute cost) is never used.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  pty-integration-linux:
    # THE PR PTY/CLI integration leg (gh-1005: the former mac leg merged in;
    # before that, issue #931 part 2 sharded ONE ~40-min job into 3
    # duration-balanced shards — scripts/test_integration_shards.json,
    # file-level units). New integration-tagged files bin-pack in at runtime
    # (shard_files.py --tags integration), so a PR adding one never
    # silently skips it. Explicit --concurrency=4 bounds in-suite
    # parallelism (part 3.3 — package:test forbids `concurrency` in
    # dart_test.yaml tag overrides, so the knob lives here; it bounds
    # concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB — the rate-limit rationale is
    # documented on the llm tag in dart_test.yaml).
    # Per-shard coverage artifacts merge in pty-coverage-gate —
    # a single shard's ratchet would see partial lib/src/cli coverage
    # and false-regress. Each shard also emits the dart json
    # file-reporter: junit feeds rebalancing/budget-tightening PRs, the
    # raw json feeds the #928 duration gate (pty-coverage-gate below).
    # gh-1300: needs the once-per-run AOT build; FA_BIN points every CLI
    # spawn (PTY harness + headless helpers) at the prebuilt binary.
    needs: [fa-aot-build]
    name: PTY/CLI integration (linux, shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    # 40 > 30: the leg now carries the coverage + file-reporter overhead the
    # old mac leg had (the coverage-free linux twin never paid it) and arm64
    # Graviton cores run somewhat slower than the M-series minis did — margin
    # without stretching the watchdog much.
    timeout-minutes: 40
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2]
    env:
      # Secret shape (review 2026-09-23): this is the pull_request-time leg
      # that receives real provider secrets. GitHub withholds secrets from
      # forks, so external contributions never see them — but every
      # SAME-REPO branch runs this suite with the keys in its process
      # environment before human review (this repo's agent-authored-branch
      # model). The marginal escalation vs the nightly (same suites, same
      # keys, post-merge on main) is small and the watchdog already hands
      # RELEASE_PAT to same-repo PRs; documented here so the assumption is
      # explicit, not implicit.
      #
      # The live-provider legs (unlocked by these keys) load extra
      # lib/src/cli surface into the coverage measurement, so a no-key run
      # measures a DIFFERENT — lower-numbered — value; missing keys (forks)
      # self-skip those legs gracefully and the gate stays honest either
      # way.
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
      OLLAMA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OLLAMA_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # gh-1300: the AOT binary built once per run by fa-aot-build. The
      # guard FAILS the shard loudly if the artifact is missing or dead —
      # a silent JIT fallback would hide the optimization from AC1's
      # before/after numbers.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: fa-aot-bin
          path: fa-local/bundle
      # Artifact zips do NOT preserve the exec bit (download-artifact
      # README: "post-download the file is no longer guaranteed to be set
      # as an executable"). Run 37446280743: `test -x` below failed
      # silently ~20 ms in on EVERY shard — the gate went red before a
      # single test ran. Restore the mode the build job shipped; the
      # smoke below still verifies the restored binary is executable and
      # boots (never a silent JIT fallback). Content integrity is not
      # affected: download-artifact digest-validates (digest-mismatch:
      # error default), so this chmod only ever touches the verified
      # bundle the fa-aot-build job produced.
      - name: Restore exec bit (artifact zips drop permissions)
        run: chmod +x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
      - name: Smoke the AOT binary (fail loud, never JIT-fallback)
        run: |
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (linux, shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn (pty_harness + the
          # headless helpers via faCliCommand) runs the AOT binary —
          # ~1 s per spawn instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on
          # loaded ARM runners). Per-test isolation is unchanged.
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          # gh-1199 AC1: --exclude-tag llm keeps every live-provider file
          # out of the merge-blocking selection (manifest unit AND runtime
          # bin-pack); --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm is the dart-test
          # backstop. AC6: the quarantine filter drops flake-quarantined
          # files (scripts/test_quarantine.json) pending their fix PRs.
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_integration_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }} --tags integration --exclude browser_ext --exclude-tag llm | python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py)
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          if [ -z "$targets" ]; then
            echo "shard fully quarantined — nothing to run"
            exit 0
          fi
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm \
            --concurrency=4 \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
      # The file-reporter writes the json even on a RED leg — convert +
      # upload must not be chained into the failing step (#928 review):
      # timing evidence is exactly what red runs need to keep.
      - name: junit durations (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json
          test-results/junit-integration-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml
      # Raw dart json for the #928 duration gate (per-test spans incl. suite
      # paths); junit is the human/rebalancer-facing form of the same data.
      # Upload MUST stay on the current upload-artifact line (gh-995): the
      # gate's download-artifact v8 digest-validates every download, so an
      # old-line upload digest-mismatches and the shard merge loses its
      # report (test/release_hygiene_test.dart pins the pin).
      #
      # gh-1412: each evidence upload carries a one-shot retry (the step
      # right after it, same pinned action). The gh-1412…

  full-quality:
    name: Full quality gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1522: the publish dry-run rehearses the tag-stamped stage —
          # tag math needs the full tag graph (blobless per gh-1477).
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - run: dart pub get

      # gh-1522: the dry-run now rehearses the REAL publish payload — the
      # staged tree stamped with the NEXT tag version — so a stamp failure
      # (placeholder leak, changelog-section generation, staged-version
      # desync) surfaces nightly, not at tag time. Publish-blocking problems
      # (undeclared lib/ imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface
      # only in the tag-time publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared
      # package:cryptography import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags.
      # --ignore-warnings: the two known layout warnings (gitignored
      # install_local.sh, docs/ naming) must not redden the nightly, while
      # validation ERRORS — "does not have X in the dependencies section of
      # pubspec.yaml" — still fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a
      # publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated
      # metadata reads, so resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the
      # publish job); --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run on the staged tree (gh-1522)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          latest=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1)
          latest="${latest#v}"
          IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$latest"
          next="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))"
          echo "rehearsing the publish of the NEXT tag: v$next"
          bash scripts/stage_publish_package.sh /tmp/publish-stage "$next"
          (cd /tmp/publish-stage && dart pub get && dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings)

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The repo-wide `dart analyze` also walks office_addin/dart; without
      # its package config the analyzer cannot resolve
      # `package:fa_office_agent/...` imports (nightly full-quality was red
      # on email_quarantine_test.dart since the add-in landed). ci.yml's
      # analyze job already does this — nightly must match.
      - name: Office add-in pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        run: dart pub get --directory=office_addin/dart

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # without it the analyzer fails with asset_does_not_exist (a fresh
      # clone hits the same warning locally).
      - name: Create placeholder .env for the example app
        run: touch [REDACTED:Credential File]

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored (real keys stay local); the
      # repo-wide analyze fails on the unresolved import without it. The
      # tracked placeholder makes it compile (Firebase init is skipped for
      # YOUR_* values at runtime).
      - name: Create placeholder firebase_options.dart for the example app
        run: >-
          cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart
          flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - name: File size guard (no dart file over 2800 lines)
        run: |
          violations=$(find lib test example -name '*.dart' \
            ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
            -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 2800 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
          if [ -n "$violations" ]; then echo "$violations"; exit 1; fi

      - name: dart analyze

      - name: dart test --coverage (excluding integration)

  dmtools <tool> --data '{"json"}'      # Execute with inline JSON
  dmtools <tool> --file params.json     # Execute with JSON file
  dmtools <tool> --verbose              # Execute with verbose output
  dmtools <tool> --debug                # Execute with debug output and error messages
  dmtools <tool> <<EOF                  # Execute with heredoc
  {"json": "data"}
  EOF

  dmtools doctor

  full-quality:
    name: Full quality gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1522: the publish dry-run rehearses the tag-stamped stage —
          # tag math needs the full tag graph (blobless per gh-1477).
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - run: dart pub get

      # gh-1522: the dry-run now rehearses the REAL publish payload — the
      # staged tree stamped with the NEXT tag version — so a stamp failure
      # (placeholder leak, changelog-section generation, staged-version
      # desync) surfaces nightly, not at tag time. Publish-blocking problems
      # (undeclared lib/ imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface
      # only in the tag-time publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared
      # package:cryptography import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags.
      # --ignore-warnings: the two known layout warnings (gitignored
      # install_local.sh, docs/ naming) must not redden the nightly, while
      # validation ERRORS — "does not have X in the dependencies section of
      # pubspec.yaml" — still fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a
      # publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated
      # metadata reads, so resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the
      # publish job); --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run on the staged tree (gh-1522)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          latest=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1)
          latest="${latest#v}"
          IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$latest"
          next="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))"
          echo "rehearsing the publish of the NEXT tag: v$next"
          bash scripts/stage_publish_package.sh /tmp/publish-stage "$next"
          (cd /tmp/publish-stage && dart pub get && dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings)

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The repo-wide `dart analyze` also walks office_addin/dart; without
      # its package config the analyzer cannot resolve
      # `package:fa_office_agent/...` imports (nightly full-quality was red
      # on email_quarantine_test.dart since the add-in landed). ci.yml's
      # analyze job already does this — nightly must match.
      - name: Office add-in pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        run: dart pub get --directory=office_addin/dart

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # without it the analyzer fails with asset_does_not_exist (a fresh
      # clone hits the same warning locally).
      - name: Create placeholder .env for the example app
        run: touch [REDACTED:Credential File]

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored (real keys stay local); the
      # repo-wide analyze fails on the unresolved import without it. The
      # tracked placeholder makes it compile (Firebase init is skipped for
      # YOUR_* values at runtime).

  full-quality:
    name: Full quality gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1522: the publish dry-run rehearses the tag-stamped stage —
          # tag math needs the full tag graph (blobless per gh-1477).
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - run: dart pub get

      # gh-1522: the dry-run now rehearses the REAL publish payload — the
      # staged tree stamped with the NEXT tag version — so a stamp failure
      # (placeholder leak, changelog-section generation, staged-version
      # desync) surfaces nightly, not at tag time. Publish-blocking problems
      # (undeclared lib/ imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface
      # only in the tag-time publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared
      # package:cryptography import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags.
      # --ignore-warnings: the two known layout warnings (gitignored
      # install_local.sh, docs/ naming) must not redden the nightly, while
      # validation ERRORS — "does not have X in the dependencies section of
      # pubspec.yaml" — still fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a
      # publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated
      # metadata reads, so resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the
      # publish job); --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run on the staged tree (gh-1522)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          latest=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1)
          latest="${latest#v}"
          IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$latest"
          next="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))"
          echo "rehearsing the publish of the NEXT tag: v$next"
          bash scripts/stage_publish_package.sh /tmp/publish-stage "$next"
          (cd /tmp/publish-stage && dart pub get && dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings)

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The repo-wide `dart analyze` also walks office_addin/dart; without
      # its package config the analyzer cannot resolve
      # `package:fa_office_agent/...` imports (nightly full-quality was red
      # on email_quarantine_test.dart since the add-in landed). ci.yml's
      # analyze job already does this — nightly must match.

  full-quality:
    name: Full quality gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1522: the publish dry-run rehearses the tag-stamped stage —
          # tag math needs the full tag graph (blobless per gh-1477).
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - run: dart pub get

      # gh-1522: the dry-run now rehearses the REAL publish payload — the
      # staged tree stamped with the NEXT tag version — so a stamp failure
      # (placeholder leak, changelog-section generation, staged-version
      # desync) surfaces nightly, not at tag time. Publish-blocking problems
      # (undeclared lib/ imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface
      # only in the tag-time publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared
      # package:cryptography import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags.
      # --ignore-warnings: the two known layout warnings (gitignored
      # install_local.sh, docs/ naming) must not redden the nightly, while
      # validation ERRORS — "does not have X in the dependencies section of
      # pubspec.yaml" — still fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a
      # publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated
      # metadata reads, so resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the
      # publish job); --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run on the staged tree (gh-1522)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          latest=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1)
          latest="${latest#v}"
          IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$latest"
          next="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))"
          echo "rehearsing the publish of the NEXT tag: v$next"
          bash scripts/stage_publish_package.sh /tmp/publish-stage "$next"
          (cd /tmp/publish-stage && dart pub get && dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings)

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The repo-wide `dart analyze` also walks office_addin/dart; without
      # its package config the analyzer cannot resolve
      # `package:fa_office_agent/...` imports (nightly full-quality was red
      # on email_quarantine_test.dart since the add-in landed). ci.yml's
      # analyze job already does this — nightly must match.
      - name: Office add-in pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        run: dart pub get --directory=office_addin/dart

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # without it the analyzer fails with asset_does_not_exist (a fresh
      # clone hits the same warning locally).
      - name: Create placeholder .env for the example app
        run: touch [REDACTED:Credential File]

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored (real keys stay local); the
      # repo-wide analyze fails on the unresolved import without it. The
      # tracked placeholder makes it compile (Firebase init is skipped for
      # YOUR_* values at runtime).
      - name: Create placeholder firebase_options.dart for the example app
        run: >-
          cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart
          flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - name: File size guard (no dart file over 2800 lines)
        run: |
          violations=$(find lib test example -name '*.dart' \
            ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
            -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 2800 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
          if [ -n "$violations" ]; then echo "$violations"; exit 1; fi

      - name: dart analyze
        run: dart analyze

      - name: dart test --coverage (excluding integration)
        run: dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): integration-tagged jsr
      # delegate suites feed the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet AND must
      # reach this unit-side lcov (the 80% ratchet + CRAP below read it) —
      # same rationale as scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core.

      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info

      - name: Coverage ratchet (lib/ >= 80%)
        run: python3 scripts/check_coverage.py 80

          except Exception:

          sys.exit(0 if float(pct) < 1.0 else 1)

  full-quality:
    name: Full quality gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1522: the publish dry-run rehearses the tag-stamped stage —
          # tag math needs the full tag graph (blobless per gh-1477).
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - run: dart pub get

      # gh-1522: the dry-run now rehearses the REAL publish payload — the
      # staged tree stamped with the NEXT tag version — so a stamp failure
      # (placeholder leak, changelog-section generation, staged-version
      # desync) surfaces nightly, not at tag time. Publish-blocking problems
      # (undeclared lib/ imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface
      # only in the tag-time publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared
      # package:cryptography import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags.
      # --ignore-warnings: the two known layout warnings (gitignored
      # install_local.sh, docs/ naming) must not redden the nightly, while
      # validation ERRORS — "does not have X in the dependencies section of
      # pubspec.yaml" — still fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a
      # publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated
      # metadata reads, so resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the
      # publish job); --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run on the staged tree (gh-1522)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          latest=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1)
          latest="${latest#v}"
          IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$latest"
          next="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))"
          echo "rehearsing the publish of the NEXT tag: v$next"
          bash scripts/stage_publish_package.sh /tmp/publish-stage "$next"
          (cd /tmp/publish-stage && dart pub get && dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings)

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The repo-wide `dart analyze` also walks office_addin/dart; without
      # its package config the analyzer cannot resolve
      # `package:fa_office_agent/...` imports (nightly full-quality was red
      # on email_quarantine_test.dart since the add-in landed). ci.yml's
      # analyze job already does this — nightly must match.
      - name: Office add-in pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        run: dart pub get --directory=office_addin/dart

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # without it the analyzer fails with asset_does_not_exist (a fresh
      # clone hits the same warning locally).
      - name: Create placeholder .env for the example app
        run: touch [REDACTED:Credential File]

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored (real keys stay local); the
      # repo-wide analyze fails on the unresolved import without it. The
      # tracked placeholder makes it compile (Firebase init is skipped for
      # YOUR_* values at runtime).
      - name: Create placeholder firebase_options.dart for the example app
        run: >-
          cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart
          flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - name: File size guard (no dart file over 2800 lines)
        run: |
          violations=$(find lib test example -name '*.dart' \
            ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
            -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 2800 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
          if [ -n "$violations" ]; then echo "$violations"; exit 1; fi

      - name: dart analyze
        run: dart analyze

      - name: dart test --coverage (excluding integration)
        run: dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): integration-tagged jsr
      # delegate suites feed the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet AND must
      # reach this unit-side lcov (the 80% ratchet + CRAP below read it) —
      # same rationale as scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core.

      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info

      - name: Coverage ratchet (lib/ >= 80%)
        run: python3 scripts/check_coverage.py 80

          except Exception:

          sys.exit(0 if float(pct) < 1.0 else 1)

  full-quality:
    name: Full quality gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1522: the publish dry-run rehearses the tag-stamped stage —
          # tag math needs the full tag graph (blobless per gh-1477).
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - run: dart pub get

      # gh-1522: the dry-run now rehearses the REAL publish payload — the
      # staged tree stamped with the NEXT tag version — so a stamp failure
      # (placeholder leak, changelog-section generation, staged-version
      # desync) surfaces nightly, not at tag time. Publish-blocking problems
      # (undeclared lib/ imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface
      # only in the tag-time publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared
      # package:cryptography import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags.
      # --ignore-warnings: the two known layout warnings (gitignored
      # install_local.sh, docs/ naming) must not redden the nightly, while
      # validation ERRORS — "does not have X in the dependencies section of
      # pubspec.yaml" — still fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a
      # publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated
      # metadata reads, so resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the
      # publish job); --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run on the staged tree (gh-1522)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          latest=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1)
          latest="${latest#v}"
          IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$latest"
          next="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))"
          echo "rehearsing the publish of the NEXT tag: v$next"
          bash scripts/stage_publish_package.sh /tmp/publish-stage "$next"
          (cd /tmp/publish-stage && dart pub get && dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings)

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The repo-wide `dart analyze` also walks office_addin/dart; without
      # its package config the analyzer cannot resolve
      # `package:fa_office_agent/...` imports (nightly full-quality was red
      # on email_quarantine_test.dart since the add-in landed). ci.yml's
      # analyze job already does this — nightly must match.
      - name: Office add-in pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        run: dart pub get --directory=office_addin/dart

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # without it the analyzer fails with asset_does_not_exist (a fresh
      # clone hits the same warning locally).
      - name: Create placeholder .env for the example app
        run: touch [REDACTED:Credential File]

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored (real keys stay local); the
      # repo-wide analyze fails on the unresolved import without it. The
      # tracked placeholder makes it compile (Firebase init is skipped for
      # YOUR_* values at runtime).
      - name: Create placeholder firebase_options.dart for the example app
        run: >-
          cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart
          flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - name: File size guard (no dart file over 2800 lines)
        run: |
          violations=$(find lib test example -name '*.dart' \
            ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
            -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 2800 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
          if [ -n "$violations" ]; then echo "$violations"; exit 1; fi

      - name: dart analyze
        run: dart analyze

      - name: dart test --coverage (excluding integration)
        run: dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration

      # delegate suites feed the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet AND must
      # reach this unit-side lcov (the 80% ratchet + CRAP below read it) —
      # same rationale as scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core.

          sys.exit(0 if float(pct) < 1.0 else 1)

      # desync) surfaces nightly, not at tag time. Publish-blocking problems
      # (undeclared lib/ imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface

      # publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated
      # metadata reads, so resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the
      # publish job); --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run on the staged tree (gh-1522)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          latest=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1)

  full-quality:
    name: Full quality gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1522: the publish dry-run rehearses the tag-stamped stage —

          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - run: dart pub get

      # gh-1522: the dry-run now rehearses the REAL publish payload — the
      # staged tree stamped with the NEXT tag version — so a stamp failure
      # (placeholder leak, changelog-section generation, staged-version
      # desync) surfaces nightly, not at tag time. Publish-blocking problems
      # (undeclared lib/ imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface
      # only in the tag-time publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared
      # package:cryptography import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags.
      # --ignore-warnings: the two known layout warnings (gitignored
      # install_local.sh, docs/ naming) must not redden the nightly, while
      # validation ERRORS — "does not have X in the dependencies section of
      # pubspec.yaml" — still fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a
      # publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated
      # metadata reads, so resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the
      # publish job); --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run on the staged tree (gh-1522)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          latest=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1)
          latest="${latest#v}"
          IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$latest"
          next="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))"
          echo "rehearsing the publish of the NEXT tag: v$next"
          bash scripts/stage_publish_package.sh /tmp/publish-stage "$next"
          (cd /tmp/publish-stage && dart pub get && dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings)

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # on email_quarantine_test.dart since the add-in landed). ci.yml's
      # analyze job already does this — nightly must match.
      - name: Office add-in pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        run: dart pub get --directory=office_addin/dart

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # without it the analyzer fails with asset_does_not_exist (a fresh
      # clone hits the same warning locally).
      - name: Create placeholder .env for the example app
        run: touch [REDACTED:Credential File]

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored (real keys stay local); the
      # repo-wide analyze fails on the unresolved import without it. The
      # tracked placeholder makes it compile (Firebase init is skipped for
      # YOUR_* values at runtime).
      - name: Create placeholder firebase_options.dart for the example app
        run: >-
          cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart
          flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - name: File size guard (no dart file over 2800 lines)
        run: |
          violations=$(find lib test example -name '*.dart' \
            ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
            -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 2800 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
          if [ -n "$violations" ]; then echo "$violations"; exit 1; fi

      - name: dart analyze
        run: dart analyze

      - name: dart test --coverage (excluding integration)
        run: dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration

  "description": "## Owner directive

Separate card from #1537. Once #1537 makes the SM pre-merge validation the single test gate, the nightly workflow must stop re-running anything that gate already covers. Nightly keeps only what belongs there by nature:

- **Builds** (all store/desktop targets, as today).
- **Integration-tagged tests** (PTY/CLI integration, LLM-calling `integration` tag) — they are deliberately excluded from pre-commit and PR gates (slow, networked, flakier), and nightly is their only home. This leg pays for itself: it caught the #1510 TUI wrap regression that unit tests could not see.

Everything else that nightly currently re-runs (unit shards, analyze, coverage, duplication/CRAP gates — audit the actual nightly workflow legs) gets REMOVED as duplication of the pre-merge gate.

1. Audit nightly workflow legs; classify each as {duplicates pre-merge gate} vs {nightly-native: builds, integration tests}; the issue body lists the classification.

4. Docs updated (AGENTS.md quality gates / docs/) to state: unit+coverage+static = pre-merge only; integration+builds = nightly.
5. If the team later wants nightly fully testless, integration tests move to on-demand/pre-release — explicitly OUT of scope here.

  full-quality:
    name: Full quality gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1522: the publish dry-run rehearses the tag-stamped stage —
          # tag math needs the full tag graph (blobless per gh-1477).
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - run: dart pub get

      # gh-1522: the dry-run now rehearses the REAL publish payload — the
      # staged tree stamped with the NEXT tag version — so a stamp failure
      # (placeholder leak, changelog-section generation, staged-version
      # desync) surfaces nightly, not at tag time. Publish-blocking problems
      # (undeclared lib/ imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface
      # only in the tag-time publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared
      # package:cryptography import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags.
      # --ignore-warnings: the two known layout warnings (gitignored
      # install_local.sh, docs/ naming) must not redden the nightly, while
      # validation ERRORS — "does not have X in the dependencies section of
      # pubspec.yaml" — still fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a
      # publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated
      # metadata reads, so resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the
      # publish job); --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run on the staged tree (gh-1522)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          latest=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1)
          latest="${latest#v}"
          IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$latest"
          next="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))"
          echo "rehearsing the publish of the NEXT tag: v$next"
          bash scripts/stage_publish_package.sh /tmp/publish-stage "$next"
          (cd /tmp/publish-stage && dart pub get && dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings)

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The repo-wide `dart analyze` also walks office_addin/dart; without
      # its package config the analyzer cannot resolve
      # `package:fa_office_agent/...` imports (nightly full-quality was red
      # on email_quarantine_test.dart since the add-in landed). ci.yml's
      # analyze job already does this — nightly must match.
      - name: Office add-in pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        run: dart pub get --directory=office_addin/dart

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # without it the analyzer fails with asset_does_not_exist (a fresh
      # clone hits the same warning locally).

  full-quality:
    name: Full quality gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1522: the publish dry-run rehearses the tag-stamped stage —
          # tag math needs the full tag graph (blobless per gh-1477).
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - run: dart pub get

      # gh-1522: the dry-run now rehearses the REAL publish payload — the
      # staged tree stamped with the NEXT tag version — so a stamp failure
      # (placeholder leak, changelog-section generation, staged-version
      # desync) surfaces nightly, not at tag time. Publish-blocking problems
      # (undeclared lib/ imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface
      # only in the tag-time publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared
      # package:cryptography import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags.
      # --ignore-warnings: the two known layout warnings (gitignored
      # install_local.sh, docs/ naming) must not redden the nightly, while
      # validation ERRORS — "does not have X in the dependencies section of
      # pubspec.yaml" — still fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a
      # publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated
      # metadata reads, so resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the
      # publish job); --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run on the staged tree (gh-1522)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          latest=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1)
          latest="${latest#v}"
          IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$latest"
          next="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))"
          echo "rehearsing the publish of the NEXT tag: v$next"
          bash scripts/stage_publish_package.sh /tmp/publish-stage "$next"
          (cd /tmp/publish-stage && dart pub get && dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings)

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The repo-wide `dart analyze` also walks office_addin/dart; without
      # its package config the analyzer cannot resolve
      # `package:fa_office_agent/...` imports (nightly full-quality was red
      # on email_quarantine_test.dart since the add-in landed). ci.yml's
      # analyze job already does this — nightly must match.
      - name: Office add-in pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        run: dart pub get --directory=office_addin/dart

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # without it the analyzer fails with asset_does_not_exist (a fresh
      # clone hits the same warning locally).
      - name: Create placeholder .env for the example app
        run: touch [REDACTED:Credential File]

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored (real keys stay local); the
      # repo-wide analyze fails on the unresolved import without it. The
      # tracked placeholder makes it compile (Firebase init is skipped for
      # YOUR_* values at runtime).
      - name: Create placeholder firebase_options.dart for the example app
        run: >-
          cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart
          flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - name: File size guard (no dart file over 2800 lines)
        run: |
          violations=$(find lib test example -name '*.dart' \
            ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
            -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 2800 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
          if [ -n "$violations" ]; then echo "$violations"; exit 1; fi

      - name: dart analyze
        run: dart analyze

      - name: dart test --coverage (excluding integration)
        run: dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): integration-tagged jsr
      # delegate suites feed the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet AND must
      # reach this unit-side lcov (the 80% ratchet + CRAP below read it) —
      # same rationale as scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core.

        run: dart test --tags integration --coverage=coverage test/cli/jsr_cli_test.dart test/cli/cli_args_jsr_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_jsr_test.dart

      - name: Format coverage to lcov
        run: dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov -i coverage -o coverage/lcov.info

      - name: Coverage ratchet (lib/ >= 80%)
        run: python3 scripts/check_coverage.py 80

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        run: |

          except Exception:

          print(f'Duplication: {pct}% (threshold < 1.0%)')
          sys.exit(0 if float(pct) < 1.0 else 1)
          EOF

  full-quality:
    name: Full quality gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1522: the publish dry-run rehearses the tag-stamped stage —
          # tag math needs the full tag graph (blobless per gh-1477).
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - run: dart pub get

      # gh-1522: the dry-run now rehearses the REAL publish payload — the
      # staged tree stamped with the NEXT tag version — so a stamp failure
      # (placeholder leak, changelog-section generation, staged-version
      # desync) surfaces nightly, not at tag time. Publish-blocking problems
      # (undeclared lib/ imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface
      # only in the tag-time publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared
      # package:cryptography import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags.
      # --ignore-warnings: the two known layout warnings (gitignored
      # install_local.sh, docs/ naming) must not redden the nightly, while
      # validation ERRORS — "does not have X in the dependencies section of
      # pubspec.yaml" — still fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a
      # publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated
      # metadata reads, so resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the
      # publish job); --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run on the staged tree (gh-1522)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          latest=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1)
          latest="${latest#v}"
          IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$latest"
          next="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))"
          echo "rehearsing the publish of the NEXT tag: v$next"
          bash scripts/stage_publish_package.sh /tmp/publish-stage "$next"
          (cd /tmp/publish-stage && dart pub get && dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings)

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # on email_quarantine_test.dart since the add-in landed). ci.yml's
      # analyze job already does this — nightly must match.
      - name: Office add-in pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        run: dart pub get --directory=office_addin/dart

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # without it the analyzer fails with asset_does_not_exist (a fresh
      # clone hits the same warning locally).
      - name: Create placeholder .env for the example app
        run: touch [REDACTED:Credential File]

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored (real keys stay local); the
      # repo-wide analyze fails on the unresolved import without it. The
      # tracked placeholder makes it compile (Firebase init is skipped for
      # YOUR_* values at runtime).
      - name: Create placeholder firebase_options.dart for the example app
        run: >-
          cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart
          flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - name: File size guard (no dart file over 2800 lines)
        run: |
          violations=$(find lib test example -name '*.dart' \
            ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
            -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 2800 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
          if [ -n "$violations" ]; then echo "$violations"; exit 1; fi

      - name: dart analyze
        run: dart analyze

      - name: dart test --coverage (excluding integration)
        run: dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): integration-tagged jsr
      # delegate suites feed the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet AND must
      # reach this unit-side lcov (the 80% ratchet + CRAP below read it) —

      # desync) surfaces nightly, not at tag time. Publish-blocking problems
      # (undeclared lib/ imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface
      # only in the tag-time publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared
      # package:cryptography import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags.

      # validation ERRORS — "does not have X in the dependencies section of

      # publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated
      # metadata reads, so resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the
      # publish job); --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run on the staged tree (gh-1522)
        run: |

          latest=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1)
          latest="${latest#v}"

          next="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))"
          echo "rehearsing the publish of the NEXT tag: v$next"
          bash scripts/stage_publish_package.sh /tmp/publish-stage "$next"

    Red 2 (mechanically proven): the steering PTY test's hardKill races the
    soft-yield turn it just triggered — steer -> yieldSource.cancel -> the
    bash job hands back at once -> step boundary -> the next /chat/completions
    request fires within milliseconds of the Ctrl+S. When the SIGKILL lands
    mid-request-send, the mock server's parser is mid-body at EOF;
    _HttpParser._onDone raises HttpException('Connection closed while
    receiving data') and _HttpIncoming.listen rethrows it with the
    request-line path (uri = /v1/chat/completions — the exact red-run
    signature). server.listen(mock._handle) had no error handling, so the
    abort escaped as an UNHANDLED ZONE ERROR in the test isolate, which dart
    test attributes to whichever test is active.

  full-quality:
    name: Full quality gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1522: the publish dry-run rehearses the tag-stamped stage —
          # tag math needs the full tag graph (blobless per gh-1477).
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - run: dart pub get

      # gh-1522: the dry-run now rehearses the REAL publish payload — the
      # staged tree stamped with the NEXT tag version — so a stamp failure
      # (placeholder leak, changelog-section generation, staged-version
      # desync) surfaces nightly, not at tag time. Publish-blocking problems
      # (undeclared lib/ imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface
      # only in the tag-time publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared
      # package:cryptography import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags.
      # --ignore-warnings: the two known layout warnings (gitignored
      # install_local.sh, docs/ naming) must not redden the nightly, while
      # validation ERRORS — "does not have X in the dependencies section of
      # pubspec.yaml" — still fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a
      # publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated
      # metadata reads, so resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the
      # publish job); --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run on the staged tree (gh-1522)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          latest=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1)
          latest="${latest#v}"
          IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$latest"
          next="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))"
          echo "rehearsing the publish of the NEXT tag: v$next"
          bash scripts/stage_publish_package.sh /tmp/publish-stage "$next"
          (cd /tmp/publish-stage && dart pub get && dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings)

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The repo-wide `dart analyze` also walks office_addin/dart; without
      # its package config the analyzer cannot resolve
      # `package:fa_office_agent/...` imports (nightly full-quality was red
      # on email_quarantine_test.dart since the add-in landed). ci.yml's
      # analyze job already does this — nightly must match.
      - name: Office add-in pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        run: dart pub get --directory=office_addin/dart
